title: System update runtime visibility and dashboard indicator (SYS-17)
acceptance_criteria: System Update Check page shows runtime command output indicating up-to-date vs update-available state.
Backend exposes best-effort structured update status endpoint with non-fatal warnings for unsupported probes.
System Information dashboard card shows update status and links to update page when update is available.
Validation gates pass: backend pytest slice, frontend typecheck/eslint/build/runtime smoke/UI smoke.
assumptions: VyOS image/update probe output can vary by build; parser remains best-effort with warnings.
This slice adds visibility only and does not perform image download/install workflows.

tasks.notes: Added /status runtime endpoint with ordered show/generate probe fallbacks and structured parsing.
Added runtime status section with warnings/raw output and preserved config-edit workflow.
Added update indicator in system information card with link to /system/update-check.
Added endpoint tests and executed all required validation gates for this slice.
Reviewer-agent unavailable due thread cap; manual in-process review completed with APPROVED verdict.
Continue remaining backlog sequence after SYS-17 with HA-01/HA-02 depth and broader option parity.
